_label: Glory…Now and ever at the Aposticha, Synaxis of the Bodiless Powers (11-08)

commemoration.title: Synaxis of the Archangel Michael and the Other Bodiless Powers

_note: The ONLY Aposticha hymn the Menaion supplies on this Sunday. On packet p.11 the director strikes the Tone 1 sticheron and both "Michael the archangel" stichera with one diagonal X and circles "Tone 8" — the Octoechos resurrectional aposticha are sung instead, and this is their Glory…Now and ever. Same two-OCA-editions split as the Lord-I-Call stichera (archangels-lic-*): the base is the service-texts DOCX, the parish sings the engraved-music setting. Register differs here as well as wording, which is why a text swap and not a pronoun flip is the fix.

_provenance.family_note: OCA. The OCA service-texts DOCX; identical to stichera.id=7990, the row it stands in for.

value.text:
Since thou, O leader of hosts, art first in rank and champion among the angels, deliver from every oppression, sorrow, sickness, and sin those who praise thee sincerely and openly implore thee! Since thou art immaterial, thou dost clearly behold Him Who is without matter. Thou shinest with the unapproachable light of the glory of the Lord, Who in His love for man took flesh for our sakes from a Virgin,
when He willed to save mankind.

value.text:
Since you, leader of hosts, are first in rank and an archangel,
deliver from every oppression, sorrow, sickness and sin
those who praise you humbly and implore you.
Since you are immaterial
you behold Him who is without matter.
You shine with the unapproachable light of the glory of the Lord,
Who in His love took flesh for our sakes from a Virgin,//
when He willed to save mankind.
